channel.title: vishal pallagani
channel.description: Experiments, results and opinions on research that catches my attention.

item.title: About a third of the best coding agents' failures are the benchmark's fault
item.description: 35–38% of the top five systems' failures on SWE-bench Verified are caused by the benchmark, with execution evidence. Labels alone, where two model families must agree, give a floor of 18%.

item.title: Mammoth with two cavapoos and a Model Y
item.description: 5.4 mi round trip to Barney Lake, about 1,200 ft of climbing. Totally doable for two small dogs if we go slow.
